steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You scared the hell out of me. Why did you grab those things? You fell asleep as soon as you touched them, and we couldn't wake you up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Do you know how long you were out?!

Your captive is on her knees, nailed to the floor by flame-red thorns that run through the black hem and stop her from dancing. You can't put the shackles on this deranged creature, but you're able to immobilize her with them.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: It hurts... It's burning hot... Let me out, let me out...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I have something to ask you, before destroying you.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I'm Hamel, why pick on Hamel...
She begins to whimper, her voice growing thinner and thinner. It's as if she were a baby.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Liar... Liar... You said you'd protect me, you said everybody liked me... Why...
Tentacles, this time carrying black flames, roll in again, smashing the shackles that bind her. But that power doesn't seem to have come from her.
A tall, lean figure flits to the scene and swings an open black umbrella to beat your back. He picks up the weeping girl and walks to the side.
The man doesn't answer. He shields Phantom Hamel with his umbrella and comforts her with gentle words.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Everything's all right, everything's all right... I'm here now, to protect you, to love you...
